Request for Proposals (RFP)
Health New Zealand is seeking proposals for a cloud-based electronic wayfinding and pathfinding solution for Manukau Health Park to improve navigation for patients, visitors and staff. The solution will provide accessible, mobile-friendly indoor navigation, helping improve the overall patient and visitor experience.
